_comment: Riverside brand theme for the graphify knowledge-graph viz. Read at build time by scripts/graph_explorer.py, which renders the branded graphify-out/graph-explorer.html (open this one; the stock graph.html is left unthemed). shape encodes node file_type; color encodes community cluster. Edit here to tune branding without touching the script. Colors: references/design-system + .claude/skills/riverside-brand-guidelines.
